subQuestions.text: What are scalar, vector and tensor quantities? Explain parallelogram law of vector addition. Describe a second order tensor quantity.

![Fig. 1](diagram_placeholder_1)

The resultant is having a magnitude $500\text{ N}$ and is acting along x-axis. Determine the unknown force $P$ and its inclination with x-axis.

The equation of motion of particle moving in a straight line is given by $s = 15t + 3t^2 - t^3$ where $s$ is the distance covered from the starting point in metre at the end of $t$ seconds. Find:
(i) the velocity and acceleration at start,
(ii) the time, when the particle reaches its maximum velocity, and
(iii) the maximum velocity of the particle

A stone is thrown vertically upwards with a velocity of $29.40\text{ m/s}$ from the top of a tower $49\text{ m}$ high. Calculate:
(i) time required for the stone to reach the ground,
(ii) velocity of the stone in its downward travel at the point in the same level as the point of projection, and
(iii) the maximum height to which the stone will rise in its flight.

Derive the relation for a circular shaft when subjected to torsion as given below
$$\frac{T}{J} = \frac{\tau}{r} = \frac{G\theta}{L}$$
Where:
$T = \text{Torque transmitted,}$
$J = \text{polar moment of inertia,}$
$\tau = \text{Max. shear stress,}$
$r = \text{Radius of the shaft,}$
$G = \text{Modulus of rigidity,}$
$\theta = \text{Angle of twist, and}$
$L = \text{Length of the shaft.}$
